2: For the music director; on the Gittith. Of Asaph. Shout out to God our strength; shout joyfully to the God of Jacob.
3: Lift up a song and strike the tambourine, the pleasant lyre, together with the harp.
4: Blow the horn at new moon, at full moon, for our feast day,
5: because it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
6: He made it a statute in Joseph when he went out against the land of Egypt, where I heard a language I did not know.
7: “I removed his shoulder from a burden. His hands were freed from the basket.
8: In this trouble you called, and I rescued you. Within the secret place of thunder I answered you; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah
9: Hear, O my people, and I will admonish you; O Israel, if you would but listen to me.
10: There shall be no strange god among you, and you shall not bow down to a foreign god.
11: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you up from the land of Egypt. Open wide your mouth and I will fill it.
12: But my people did not listen to my voice, and Israel did not yield to me.
13: So I let them go in the stubbornness of their heart; they walked in their counsels.
14: Oh that my people would listen to me; that Israel would walk in my ways.
15: I would subdue their enemies quickly, and turn my hand against their adversaries.
16: Those who hate Yahweh would cringe before him, and their fate would be forever.
17: But he would feed him from the choicest wheat, and I would satisfy you with honey from a rock.”
